# Neuromorphic_Sensor_Fusion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of integrating spiking neural network processing directly into sensor front-ends to enable low-latency, event-driven perception in electronic warfare and communication systems. Enables real-time, energy-efficient processing of dense sensor streams, critical for next-gen battlefield awareness and adaptive communication.
